caseNameFull: North Shore Corp. v. Barnett and North Shore Corp. v. Scott
attorneys: Mr. W. Gregory Smith for petitioner., Mr. Luden H. Boggs for respondents in No. 345.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The judgments of the Circuit Court of Appeals are vacated, the judgments of the District Court are modified in accordance with the stipulations signed by counsel for the parties and the cases are remanded to the District Court for the Southern District of Florida with directions to enter judgments as modified.
